topic: Fox tracks in the snowy orchard
title_jp: {雪|ゆき}の{上|うえ}の{足跡|あしあと}
context: Monday 28 December, the day offices close for the year: heavy snow fell overnight. {健太|けんた} messages from the guesthouse, and アルちゃん describes the small tracks he's found in the white orchard.
scene: Monday morning after a big snowfall. {健太|けんた} messages from the guesthouse while you're out in the orchard, looking at strange little footprints.

phrases.jp: {外|そと}は{一面|いちめん|all over, the whole surface|3}の{銀世界|ぎんせかい|snowy landscape (silver world)|2}だね。
phrases.en: Outside, everything is white with snow.
phrases.note: {銀世界|ぎんせかい} is a poetic word for a snow-covered view. Weather reports love it.

phrases.jp: {家|いえ}を{出た|でた}とたん、{雪|ゆき}が{降り出した|ふりだした|to start falling|3}。
phrases.en: The moment I left the house, it started to snow.

phrases.jp: {昨夜|ゆうべ}は、かなり{積もりました|つもりました|to pile up (snow)|3}ね。
phrases.en: A lot of snow settled last night, didn't it?
phrases.note: A safe small-talk line with neighbours all winter.

phrases.jp: {雪|ゆき}がサラサラで、{歩きやすい|あるきやすい}です。
phrases.en: The snow is powdery, so it's easy to walk on.
phrases.note: サラサラ = dry and loose. Wet heavy snow is ベチャベチャ.

dialogue_setting: LINE, Monday morning. You're in the orchard behind the 田中 house, in snow up to your knees.

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: アルちゃん、{起きとる|おきとる|(Kansai) are you up|3}？{外|そと}、めっちゃ{積もっとる|つもっとる|(Kansai) has piled up|3}で！
dialogue.en: アルちゃん, you up? There's loads of snow outside!
dialogue.note: Kansai 〜とる = 〜ている. めっちゃ = とても.

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: ドア{開けた|あけた}とたん、{雪|ゆき}がドサッと{落ちて|おちて}きてん。{頭|あたま}まで{真っ白|まっしろ|pure white|4}やｗ
dialogue.en: The second I opened the door, a pile of snow fell on me. White right up to my head lol
dialogue.note: きてん = きたんだ (Kansai). ドサッ = the thud of a heavy load falling.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: こっちも{畑|はたけ|field, orchard|3}が{一面|いちめん|all over, the whole surface|3}{真っ白|まっしろ|pure white|4}！{外|そと}に{出た|でた}とたん、{眼鏡|めがね|glasses|4}が{曇った|くもった|to fog up|3}よ
dialogue.en: Here too, the whole orchard is white! The moment I stepped outside, my glasses fogged up.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: あと、{雪|ゆき}の{上|うえ}に{小さい|ちいさい}{足跡|あしあと|footprints|3}が{一列|いちれつ}に{続いてる|つづいてる|to continue, go on|4}🐾
dialogue.en: Also, there's a line of small footprints going across the snow 🐾

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: どんな{形|かたち}？{猫|ねこ}ちゃうん？
dialogue.en: What shape? Isn't it a cat?

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {猫|ねこ}より{細長い|ほそながい|long and thin|3}。{木|き}の{下|した}で、ふさふさの{尻尾|しっぽ|tail|3}が{見えた|みえた}！
dialogue.en: Longer and thinner than a cat's. Under a tree I saw a fluffy tail!
dialogue.note: ふさふさ = thick and fluffy (tails, hair).

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: それキツネやで！{冬|ふゆ}は{山|やま}から{下りて|おりて}くるって、{田中|たなか}さん{言うとった|いうとった|(Kansai) was saying|3}わ
dialogue.en: That's a fox! 田中さん said they come down from the mountains in winter.
dialogue.note: {言|い}うとった = {言|い}っていた (Kansai).

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {写真|しゃしん}{撮ろう|とろう}としたとたん、{走って|はしって}{行っちゃった|いっちゃった}😭
dialogue.en: The moment I went to take a photo, it ran off 😭

dialogue.speaker: 健太
dialogue.jp: {今日|きょう}は{役場|やくば|town hall|2}も{仕事納め|しごとおさめ|last workday of the year|3}やし、{町|まち}も{静か|しずか}やな
dialogue.en: The town hall finishes for the year today too, so the town's nice and quiet.

listening.intro: At noon the town loudspeakers crackle across the snowy fields.
listening.title: {町|まち}のお{知らせ|しらせ}
listening.place: {鷹ノ原町|たかのはらまち}の{防災無線|ぼうさいむせん|town emergency loudspeakers|2}

lines.jp: こちらは{鷹ノ原町役場|たかのはらまちやくば}です。{役場|やくば|town hall|2}は{本日|ほんじつ}が{仕事納め|しごとおさめ|last workday of the year|3}です。
lines.en: This is {鷹ノ原|たかのはら} Town Hall. Today is the town hall's last working day of the year.

lines.jp: {年始|ねんし|start of the year|2}は、1{月|がつ}4{日|か}{月曜日|げつようび}から{開きます|ひらきます}。{雪道|ゆきみち}に{気|き}をつけて、よいお{年|とし}を。
lines.en: In the new year it opens from Monday 4 January. Mind the snowy roads, and have a good New Year.

listening.question: {役場|やくば}は{何日|なんにち}から{開きますか|ひらきますか}。
listening.explain: 1{月|がつ}4{日|か}{月曜日|げつようび}から{開|ひら}きます = it opens from Monday 4 January.

grammar.form: {動詞|どうし}た{形|けい} + とたん(に) ({開|あ}ける → {開|あ}けたとたん, {出|で}る → {出|で}たとたん, {撮|と}ろうとする → {撮|と}ろうとしたとたん)
grammar.explanation: The moment A happened, B happened, suddenly and often unexpectedly. B is something that happened, not your plan or a request: you can't say {家|いえ}に{着|つ}いたとたん、{寝|ね}よう. 〜てすぐ is the neutral 'right after'.

examples.jp: {立った|たった}とたん、{足|あし}が{滑った|すべった}。
examples.en: The moment I stood up, my foot slipped.

examples.jp: {電車|でんしゃ}で{座った|すわった}とたん、{寝ちゃった|ねちゃった}。
examples.en: I fell asleep the second I sat down on the train.

quiz.question: ドアを＿＿とたん、{猫|ねこ}が{入って|はいって}きた。
quiz.en: The moment I opened the door, the cat came in.
quiz.explain: とたん always follows the た-form: {開|あ}けたとたん.

quiz_more.question: {外|そと}に＿＿、{眼鏡|めがね}が{曇った|くもった}。
quiz_more.en: The moment I went out, my glasses fogged up.
quiz_more.explain: た-form + とたん for 'the moment'. たびに means 'every time'.

quiz_more.question: {家|いえ}に{着いた|ついた}とたん、＿＿。
options: ご飯を食べるつもりだ
quiz_more.explain: After とたん comes something that suddenly happened, not a plan or a request.

kanji.where: A yellow road sign on the farm road outside the 田中 house.
kanji.breakdown: {凍結|とうけつ}: 凍 freeze + 結 tie, set hard → 'frozen over'; {注意|ちゅうい}: 注 pour + 意 mind → 'pay attention'.
kanji.related: {凍|こお}る = to freeze; {路面凍結|ろめんとうけつ} = icy road surface.

tip.title: {仕事納め|しごとおさめ}
tip.body: Government offices close from 29 December to 3 January, so 28 December is their {仕事納め|しごとおさめ}, and many companies stop around the same day. Shops, onsen and guesthouses keep going: New Year is their busy season.

challenge.prompt: {健太|けんた}: 「キツネの{写真|しゃしん}、{撮れた|とれた}？」 Tell him it ran away the moment you tried to take one.
challenge.model_answer: {写真|しゃしん}を{撮ろう|とろう}としたとたん、{逃げちゃった|にげちゃった|to run away|4}。
challenge.explanation: {撮|と}ろうとする = try to take (a photo); its た-form + とたん marks the exact moment. {逃|に}げちゃった (= {逃|に}げてしまった) adds 'and, sadly, it got away'. Casual, right for {健太|けんた}.
challenge.hint: volitional + とした + とたん

vocab.note: {真|ま}っ adds 'completely': {真|ま}っ{暗|くら}, {真|ま}っ{赤|か}.
{一面|いちめん}の{雪|ゆき} = snow as far as you can see.

vocab.en: to fog up; to get cloudy
vocab.note: {眼鏡|めがね}が{曇|くも}る, {空|そら}が{曇|くも}る. {曇|くも}り = cloudy weather.
Intransitive: the thing goes on by itself. {続|つづ}ける = to keep doing.
{細|ほそ}い thin + {長|なが}い long.
Usually written in kana: しっぽ.
Towns and villages have a {役場|やくば}; cities have a {市役所|しやくしょ}.
Pair: {仕事始|しごとはじ}め = first workday of the new year.

kanji_study.parts: A picture of a face: an outer outline with 目 an eye in the middle → face, and then any surface.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 画 (picture): 画 is open at the top with 田 inside.

kanji_study.parts: 覀 a cover + 女 woman → originally a woman's waist, the pivot that holds the body together: essential, need.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 栗 (chestnut): 栗 has 木 tree under 覀, 要 has 女.
